## A - Exam authority, Section Thirteen Penalties

This dossier supports first-time never-licensed applicants preparing for the regular passenger-car written knowledge test in Virginia. The issuing authority is the Virginia Department of Motor Vehicles. Handbook facts in this section come from the Virginia Driver's Manual pages on penalties, covering suspension and revocation with their return paths, conviction-triggered actions, the driver improvement and medical review programs, insurance and support suspensions, and alcohol law from implied consent to underage penalties. The official question count, test format, and time limit are not stated on the assigned pages, so this dossier asserts no value for any of them. Every threshold and distance in these pages lives as a cited knowledge fact in part C, not as exam-meta values here. Practice scoring follows only the accepted LearningLoop product policy.
